title: Aspartate Aminotransferase Assay Protocol
author: Peter Havel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ybvfsn6

steps.title: Add Samples to Microplate
steps.instruction: Dispense 5 μl of each sample or standard in duplicate into the microplate wells, ensuring no bubbles are introduced.

steps.title: Incubate with AST Reagent Solution
steps.instruction: Add 50 μl of AST Reagent Solution to the wells and incubate at 37°C for 10 min under adhesive film.

steps.title: Incubate with AST Color Reagent
steps.instruction: Remove the adhesive film, add 50 μl AST Color Reagent to the wells, and incubate at 37°C for 10 min under a second adhesive film.

steps.title: Stop Reaction and Measure Absorbance
steps.instruction: Remove the adhesive film and add 200 μl 0.1 M HCl to each well, then read the absorbance at 510 nm using a plate reader.

steps.title: Calculate Results
steps.instruction: Construct a standard curve by plotting the average absorbance of serially-diluted oxaloacetate standards against their concentration in U/l to calculate unknown values.
